Andhra Pradesh CM Orders Speeding Up of Amaravati Capital Projects

Andhra Pradesh Chief Minister N. Chandrababu Naidu has instructed contract agencies to accelerate development work in Amaravati, the state's capital region. The directive emphasizes the need to avoid any delays in the ongoing projects. This focus on expediting infrastructure development aims to ensure timely completion of the capital's construction.
